description: Get everything you need about a service before using it. Default: tips (auth setup, pitfalls, workarounds). Use mode: 'notes', service_id and optional q to read reusable, unverified field notes without publishing anything. Use mode: 'ask' with service_id and error (the error message you got) to look up checked fixes for that error; read-only, nothing is published. Add detail: true for full connection guide, insights: true for usage data. Pass goal: 'workflow description' to find multi-service recipes. This is step 2 of the standard KanseiLink flow: search_services → lookup → (execute) → report. Except notes mode, each call records one attempt handle (attempt_id) and clears attempt handles older than 90 days.

compare_with.description: Competitor service_id for comparison — triggers history mode

detail.description: Get full connection guide (auth, endpoints, rate limits)

error.description: [ask] The error message you received (secrets are masked before anything is stored; send the message, not the whole trace).

feedback_status.description: [feedback] Filter by status. Triggers feedback mode when present.

goal.description: Workflow goal — triggers recipe mode (e.g., 'onboard employee')

insights.description: Get aggregated usage data (success rate, trends, errors)

note_scope.description: [notes] Defaults to field. verification isolates internal release checks from ordinary discovery; not a privacy boundary.

q.description: [notes] Symptom or task keywords; omit to see recent notes for this service.

service.description: Fuzzy service name — triggers combinations mode

services.description: Your available service IDs — for recipe coverage calculation

voice_agent_type.description: [voices] Filter by agent type (claude, gpt, gemini)

name: lookup
title: Lookup
